chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Thal'abah and others, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The correction/management of wealth is from faith.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between wealth management and faith in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes that the proper organization and preservation of wealth (islah al-mal) is intrinsically linked to faith, reflecting the Shia emphasis on practical piety in daily economic life. This narration underscores that financial stewardship is not merely a secular duty but a spiritual indicator, where orderliness in material affairs demonstrates the believer's commitment to divine trust. Such teachings highlight the holistic nature of Iman, integrating worldly responsibilities with religious devotion.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba and other, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Correction of the wealth is from the faith’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Tha’labah and others from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Keeping one’s wealth in a proper shape is part of belief.’”
